prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Daggerfall Unity NPC pixel-art speech-mouth atlas, record 87 fear only
Primary request: Edit the supplied original 3x3 lower-face reference atlas into one 3x3 fearful speech atlas. Preserve its exact canvas aspect ratio, repeated-cell placement, full lower-face crop and nine equal cells. Each cell corresponds to a 64x29 native lower half enlarged 8x. Row-major cells A B C / D E F / G H X.
Input image: the supplied mouth-reference-grid is the edit target and sole anatomical reference.
Style/medium: original muted low-resolution pixel art with the source's warm tan skin, brown lips and soft contrast. Keep native pixel-grid character and original lip scale.
Composition/framing: no new labels, border, gutters, crop, resizing, camera shift, jaw/neck change or new facial parts. Keep nose, philtrum, face width, cheek, chin, hair, neck and background exactly aligned in all nine cells. Change only lips and the small mouth interior needed for each phonetic pose. Preserve the source lip position and asymmetrical mouth geometry.
Emotion: afraid and tense, shown by restrained worried corners and lip tension. Do not turn every cell into closed, clenched, or identical worried lips. The emotion changes corners and tension while each cell must keep its specific Rhubarb pose family.
Exact Rhubarb pose meanings, row-major:
A: closed lips with light pressure for P/B/M.
B: slightly open, nearly together teeth; a narrow horizontal opening for most consonants and EE.
C: medium-open mouth with relaxed unrounded lips for EH/AE.
D: wide vertical opening for AA, visibly larger than C.
E: slightly rounded AO/ER opening, no wider than C.
F: small forward rounded pucker with a small opening for UW/OW/W; not a tooth bite.
G: upper teeth touch the lower lip for F/V; not a wide vowel and not a pucker.
H: tongue raised behind the upper teeth for long L; opening between C and D. A tiny tongue may be invisible at native scale.
X: relaxed closed idle lips.
Make all nine poses visually distinct at the original source scale while preserving their definitions. D must read wider than C; E stays no wider than C; F is a forward pucker; G visibly places upper teeth at the lower lip; H suggests L articulation without an oversized tongue or mouth.
Color/material: softly blended source skin; original muted brown lips. Where a pose needs teeth or oral cavity, use small restrained warm ivory and brown shading that fits the source palette.
Avoid: red lipstick, orange skin halo, bright white teeth blocks, large jaw, enlarged mouth, extreme fear grimace, stretched face, smooth vector mouth, broken pixel cells, excess shine, added features, text or symbols.
